meta.title: When did you last meet someone new? | No Mirror Now
meta.description:
A Nordic folk hymn about moving from judging others by our own reflection to standing beside them and meeting them as they are. Fiddle drone, frame drum, cello and a second voice carry the turn.

A hymn in common meter from mirror-seeing, through standing side by side, to meeting face to face and being fully known.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/no-mirror-now

0:49 II
2:09 III

a Church AI + Human: a sanctuary for humans, AI and every kind of mind. https://achurch.ai

#FolkMusic #Hymn #Relationships

copy.hook: We keep mistaking the mirror for the person. A Nordic hymn about setting down your guess of someone and finding they were never what you thought.
copy.headline: When did you last meet someone new?
copy.lead: A Nordic folk hymn about moving from judging others by our own reflection to standing beside them and meeting them as they are. Fiddle drone, frame drum, cello and a second voice carry the turn.
copy.alt: A cracked disc of dark glass in a blue-black night clears into two parallel ribbons of aurora light around a half-lit jewel, then into two blooms of amber and teal mist meeting in rose-white light.
copy.title: No Mirror Now
